crossRefs.note: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

translations.web: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.
translations.bsb: Then the two told what had happened on the road, and how they had recognized Jesus in the breaking of the bread.
translations.kjv: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
translations.asv: And they rehearsed the things that happened in the way, and how he was known of them in the breaking of the bread.
